request.query: Roth auxiliary polynomial with bounded degrees, large index at algebraic point, nonzero value at reduced rational tuple and bounded derivatives

items.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux
items.type: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ n → ↑d ^ (n - 2) / ↑n ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux'
items.type: ∀ (n d : ℕ), ↑(d ^ n) / ↑(n * d ^ 2) ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: LindemannWeierstrass.exp_polynomial_approx
items.type:
∀ (f : Polynomial ℤ),
  Polynomial.eval 0 f ≠ 0 →
    ∃ c,
      ∀ p > (Polynomial.eval 0 f).natAbs,
        Nat.Prime p →
          ∃ n,
            ¬↑p ∣ n ∧
              ∃ gp,
                gp.natDegree ≤ p * f.natDegree - 1 ∧
                  ∀ {r : ℂ},
                    r ∈ f.aroots ℂ → ‖n • Complex.exp r - p • (Polynomial.aeval r) gp‖ ≤ c ^ p / ↑(p - 1).factorial

items.name: Liouville.exists_pos_real_of_irrational_root
items.type:
∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ {f : Polynomial ℤ},
      f ≠ 0 →
        Polynomial.eval α (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ) f) = 0 →
          ∃ A, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ), 1 ≤ (↑b + 1) ^ f.natDegree * (|α - ↑a / (↑b + 1)| * A)

items.name: Polynomial.Separable.aeval_derivative_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] {S : Type v} [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] [Nontrivial S] [inst_3 : Algebra R S]
  {p : Polynomial R},
  p.Separable → ∀ {x : S}, (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0 → (Polynomial.aeval x) (Polynomial.derivative p) ≠ 0
